sn54.4:1.1: Ānāpānasati bhikkhave bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā || kathaṃ bhāvitā ca bhikkhave ānāpānasati katham bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā || || 4--10. Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā nisīdati- osato passati || vitthāro || yāva paṭinissaggānupassī Assasissāmīti sikkhati || paṭinissaggānupassī Passasissāmīti sikkhati || || Evam bhāvitā kho bhikkhave ānāpānasati evam bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā || || Evam bhāvitāya kho bhikkhave ānāpānasatiyā evam bahulīkatāya dvinnam phalānam aññataram phalam pāṭikaṅkhaṃ || diṭṭheva dhamme aññā sati vā upādisese anāgāmitā ti || ||
